use_when.statement: Use a card to group related content into one surface a user can scan or act on. The card owns the surface, border, radius and padding; everything inside comes from a card layout placed in ↳Layout.
use_when.verbatim: Use a card to group related content into one surface a user can scan or act on. The card owns the surface, border, radius and padding; everything inside comes from a card layout placed in ↳Layout.

dont_use_when.verbatim: Don’t nest a card inside another card.

placement.statement: as a page-level surface holding a card layout in its Layout slot

a11y.fact: becomes operable only when given an onClick and not disabled: it then takes role="button" and tabIndex 0, so it is never a focusable element with nothing to do
when interactive, Enter activates on key down and Space on key up, which is how a real button behaves
aria-disabled marks a disabled card without removing it from the accessibility tree
